preregistered_structural_law.prediction_timing: At t, compute inputs only from bars ending at t-1; emit both predictions before observing the t+1 close; fit only on labels settled strictly before the training cutoff.

regime_context.volatility_rank: ATR(t-1) ranked against the 48 prior valid ATR observations ending t-2 through t-49; <=0.20 LOW_VOL, >=0.80 HIGH_VOL, otherwise unclassified.
regime_context.activity_rank: tick_volume(t-1) ranked against the 48 prior bars ending t-2 through t-49; <=0.20 LOW_ACTIVITY, >=0.80 HIGH_ACTIVITY, otherwise unclassified.
regime_context.session_overlap: UTC hour 13 through 15 inclusive is OVERLAP; all other UTC hours are NON_OVERLAP.
regime_context.unclassified_context: Exclude the observation from both models.

paired_models.baseline: Online logistic regression with intercept and one-hot encoding of the eight frozen regime-context states.
paired_models.augmented: Same logistic regression and context inputs plus lagged log returns at t-1, t-2, t-3 and mean absolute log return over the 12 bars ending t-1.
paired_models.return_scaling: Divide each of the three lagged returns by the mean absolute return over the same 12-bar window; clip each ratio to [-10,10]. The fourth input is the unscaled mean absolute return.
paired_models.training: Chronological prequential updates on eligible training observations only; emit each score before its label update. Freeze both weight vectors at the cutoff and never update during outer evaluation.
paired_models.prediction: Stable logistic probability of an up label.

preregistered_structural_law.interpretation: Positive values indicate lower non-economic out-of-sample probabilistic prediction error for the augmented model; this is not PnL or economic value.

inference.partition: Sort distinct eligible outer-evaluation UTC dates chronologically; first floor(N/2) dates form half 1 and remaining dates form half 2.
inference.daily_cluster: Within each UTC date, average paired per-observation Brier-score improvement.
inference.raw_support: Both halves eligible, both mean improvements >0, and both one-sided p-values <=0.05.

preregistered_structural_law.missing_data: No fill, interpolation, resampling or synthetic bars; any timestamp delta other than exactly 300 seconds starts a new segment, and labels cannot cross segments.
preregistered_structural_law.duplicate_timestamps: Collapse only rows identical in parsed OHLC and tick volume; conflicting duplicates fail closed.
preregistered_structural_law.input_validation: Require finite positive OHLC, valid OHLC bounds, nonnegative finite tick volume, UTC timestamps within the frozen interval, exact M5 member identity and exact accepted archive hashes.
